goal: How to remove a stuck light bulb.
candidate_1: Press the center of a foot-long strip of duct tape onto the middle of the bulb. Fold each loose end in half so it sticks onto itself. Gripping each end between your thumb and index finger, give a clockwise twist to loosen the bulb.
candidate_2: Press the center of a foot-long strip of duct tape onto the middle of the bulb. Fold each loose end in half so it sticks onto itself. Gripping each end between your thumb and index finger, give a counterclockwise twist to loosen the bulb.
attention_note: Head-averaged slices; goal slice excludes other keys; cross slice omits CLS sink; rows need not sum to one.
